newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market light, firm-up $1-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market light, firm-up $1-USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were firm to $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 108.00 to mostly 110.00.
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 108.00- 110.00.

Trade on slaughter steers and heifers slow on Tuesday morning. Prices not established on either class on a live basis. Buyer inquiry moderate to good, seller interest limited, most refusing current bids.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - No confirmed sales. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1125 lbs 66.00.
